cohort: The study included 186 hysterectomy cases (62 vNOTES hysterectomy, 62 VH, and 62 TLH) with benign indications diagnosed between 2021 and 2022.
finding: vNOTES hysterectomy was associated with the least hemoglobin decline, shortest discharge times, and lowest 6th-hour pain score, suggesting it is a safe alternative to TLH and VH despite having the longest operation time and VH being the least costly.
